title: Bounce Sidebar
description: A vertical navigation list whose dot indicator hops to the selected item on a sideways arc with a light spring.

loop.script: click[5] → wait → click[1] → wait → click[3] → wait → click[2] → wait

docs:
Installed `BounceSidebar`. Import it from `@/components/ui/bounce-sidebar` and pass `items` (`id`, `label`, optional `href`, `icon`, `disabled`). Items with `href` render links (aria-current=page on the selected one); the others render buttons.

Use `value`/`onValueChange` to drive it from your router. The dot follows the reading direction and jumps instead of hopping under reduced motion. The indicator color is `bg-primary`; restyle it with `indicatorClassName`.

Ported from starc007/ui-components, beUI (MIT, copyright 2026 Saurabh Chauhan); the license text is in the file.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: React.ReactNode; href?: string; icon?: React.ReactNode; disabled?: boolean; target?: string; rel?: string }[]

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when an item is chosen.

a11y: A nav landmark with a list; the selected item has aria-current=page, and links keep their native semantics.
Focus is visible on every item (ring with offset); disabled items are skipped by links and disabled as buttons.
Reduced motion: the dot jumps to the selected item instead of hopping.
usage:
<BounceSidebar
  items={[{ id: "overview", label: "Overview" }, { id: "motion", label: "Motion" }]}
  value={active}
  onValueChange={setActive}
/>
